trial_court: Court of learned Additional District Judge, Kathua (File No. 06/HM Act)
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2005 and have a minor daughter who is suffering from an under-developed hip joint by birth. The husband filed a petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The wife seeks transfer of the case to the court of learned District Judge, Samba due to her difficulty in attending proceedings with her child.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of law with regard to transfer of cases, especially regarding matrimonial disputes, is that it is always the convenience of the wife which has to be given due weightage for ordering the transfer of proceedings at or near the place where the wife is residing.
legal_principles.held: As is evident from the cases referred to above, the principle of law with regard to transfer of cases especially regarding matrimonial disputes is quite settled, where consistent opinion is that it is always the convenience of wife which has to be given due weightage for ordering the transfer of proceedings at or near the place where the wife is residing.
cited_cases: Anupama Patil v. Nataraj Veerangaounda Patil, (2018) 5 SCC 354

outcome.final_order: The divorce petition is ordered to be transferred to the court of learned District Judge, Samba. The trial court is directed to transmit the record of the case.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on jurisdictional issues in family disputes
assisting with transfer of cases between courts
